verdict.rationale: Yubico's YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API is publicly documented as the programmatic surface for fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management, which covers part of lifecycle tracking. The official ykman CLI offers fully scriptable device configuration (applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots) that can drive bulk setup. The evidence only names these surfaces in probe summaries and never describes pre-registration of credentials, and community posts note there is no easy way to know which accounts a key is enrolled with. Missing for 10: any evidence of pre-registration/pre-enrolled credentials, a documented first-party bulk-provisioning workflow beyond scripting ykman, detail on how issued keys are tracked and revoked, and independent hands-on corroboration of fleet use.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys
